why.margin_floor: Distribution gross margin floor; the pricing model never recommends below it.
why.price_tolerance_abs: Component unit costs run to fractions of a cent, so the absolute bill tolerance is half a cent.
why.finance_approvers: Only finance approves a price; a reply from any other address is not acted on.
why.pricing.quote_cost: Rough cost of preparing and following up one quote, subtracted in expected profit.
